title: Redesign Completed selected file summary
summary: Redesigns the Completed Selected File summary from a raw prose block into a decision-first structured summary with status, trust, primary concern, recommended next check, compact evidence, collapsed paths, and a muted read-only authority footer.
reason: Operators need the selected Completed row to answer whether the output can be trusted and what to inspect next without parsing long raw evidence text first.
behavior_before: The Completed Selected File panel rendered completedSelectedAtAGlanceLines into completed-selected-summary as newline prose inside a pre block, with paths and authority mixed into the main text.
behavior_after: completed-selected-summary remains the selected-summary target but renders structured DOM sections; completed-detail continues to hold the full raw/detail evidence below the summary.
tests_added: Extended tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py to assert the structured Completed selected-summary container and renderer labels/classes are served.

Extended tests/webview/test_webview_browser_large_table_smoke.py to assert a selected Completed review row displays primary concern, recommended next check, route, size change, audio count, subtitle count, table visibility, paths, and authority in completed-selected-summary.
Extended tests/webview/test_webview_row_detail_smoke.py to assert the high-risk Completed selected summary renders the decision-first sections and evidence counts.
